Title: One Fine Day

Cast

1. Ayaan - 9 years, son
Look: striped T-shirt, brown trousers
2. Zoya - 10 years, daughter
Look: green salwar-kurta, short hair
3. Anita - 38 years, mother
Look: blue saree, hair in a bun

Places

1. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant
2. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window

Scene 1: The courtyard - Day

[Ayaan stands in the courtyard. Anita and Zoya stand near him.]

Ayaan: "What lovely weather!"

[A dust storm sweeps across the village.]

Ayaan: "Careful!"

[Dry leaves fall from the trees.]

Ayaan: "Mom, look at this."

[Flower petals rain down on Ayaan.]

Zoya: "Really?"

[A flock of birds flies across the sky.]

Ayaan: "How beautiful!"

[Smoke rises from the chimney.]

Anita: "Zoya, listen!"

[Ayaan lights a bonfire.]

Anita: "One more time!"

Scene 2: The living room - Day

Anita: "Let's begin."

[Ayaan puts on his school uniform.]

Ayaan: "Zoya, look at this."

[Ayaan combs his hair in front of the mirror.]

Zoya (excited): "I knew it!"

[Ayaan puts on his shoes and ties the laces.]

Zoya: "Hmm, I see."

[Zoya applies kajal to her eyes.]

Zoya: "Slowly, take it easy."

[Zoya puts on red lipstick.]

Ayaan: "What a day to remember!"
